تعتمدي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَمِدِي (taʕtamidī) /taʕ.ta.mi.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# تُعْتَمَدِي (tuʕtamadī) /tuʕ.ta.ma.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
